hints.title: Nested Encoded Bracket Parsing Obstacle
hints.text: Brackets can be nested arbitrarily deep inside multipliers. How can storing parent state before entering a bracket allow you to resume accurately upon encountering the closing bracket?

hints.title: Hierarchical Context Invariant
hints.text: When opening a bracket, stash the preceding string prefix and repetition count, and on closing bracket, repeat current string and append to previous context.

hints.title: Context Stashing and Unwinding Procedure
hints.text: Maintain currStr and currNum. When encountering a digit, update currNum. When encountering '[', store (currStr, currNum) and reset both. When encountering ']', restore (prevStr, k) and set currStr = prevStr + currStr * k. Else append char to currStr.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: M: total length of decoded string output (1 <= M <= 10^5)
complexity.notes: Linear time with respect to the generated decoded output length.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeatedly searching for innermost brackets using string search takes quadratic time O(N^2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Context buffering unwinds brackets in a single pass proportional to decoded character count.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Clean separation of multi-digit numbers and proper nesting context unwinding.
